chapters.what: Where it started: visual design for Sarge in Lagos, full time. Interfaces first, then brands, then 3D.
A peer-to-peer marketplace. I built its design from the early stage, product and brand, as it grew, including the verification system that made it safer to trade.
UX design for Haus des Stiftens in Germany, on a remote contract. Around the same time I went through Digital Product School.
I lead design at CHAOSS: open source health and community tooling, alongside maintainers around the world.
Design for OSCAFEST, the largest open source festival in Africa: identity, stage, and everything people hold in their hands.
Brand design for GitSkilled, GitHub’s open source skills program for Africans.
Brand design for the Open Source Sustainability Lab in the US, on a contract.
Short-lets and rentals in Lagos. I designed the Bulvds Wallet: payments, refunds and commissions in one place.
Ventures in commerce and payments for African users, from WhatsApp-native shopping to splitting bills with friends.
Figma plugins like LineCraft and MeshCraft, and a recorder that turns prototypes into videos. When the tool is missing, I make it.
3D assets I publish for free on Unsplash, used across platforms like Notion, Typeform, Figma, Trello, Medium, Squarespace, Prezi, Wix and Unfold.
